description: Named the Tuesday salting and the loaf, still a penny and still short.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Noted the quiet night and took his shoulders for Tuesday.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Went out from his pew. He did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Turned the glass twice and did not hail Sir John.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Heard the glass, did not hail Sir John, and named a quarter past ten.
name: William Shakespeare
